title: China rebuffs Philippines president's South China Seas rebuke
text: China rebuffs Philippines president's South China Seas rebuke Thursday, 16 August 2018 ( 9 hours ago ) BEIJING (Reuters) - China rebuffed Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte's call for Beijing to rethink its conduct in the South China Sea on Thursday, saying China had the right to react to foreign ships or aircraft that get close to its islands. ▶ China Threatens Foreign Ships Every Day 00:41 According to Business Insider, China threatens foreign ships and planes operating in the South China Sea on a "daily" basis.
